anchorAudit.rationale: The source and 1600×900 output were inspected at native pixels. Every retained term points to an independently visible dairy, produce, storage, refrigeration, doorway, room-fabric or utility object or part. Brands, printed labels, temperatures, stock status and operating claims are excluded.
